thread:
sophie: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — vendor auth + model-registry outage. Need clear owners, timelines, and recurrence detection. TL;DR: auth TTL rotation caused token churn -> model-registry webhook failures -> cascade to hosted inference. Who can own mitigations?

raj: I can take the auth provider TTL rotation and the reissue/backfill job. Plan: spike this week to prove safe rolling rotation, then two-sprint rollout with feature flag.

maria: I will own the model-registry side — durable webhook queue + exponential backoff + idempotency. We should also add a retry DLQ and an S3-backed backstop.

jordan: I'll coordinate cloud control-plane failover tests and region warm pools. We need to validate routing fallback to cheaper model variants during control-plane flaps.

elaine: I'll update the postmortem actions doc & track in the incident tracker. Please add clear ETA and test criteria. We want a gating checklist before closing the action items.

ops-bot: Created ticket INC-4523 and assigned to raj for auth-ttl-rotation. Created ticket INC-4524 for maria (model-registry-queue).

sophie: Quick dev details for the rotation spike:
```json
{
  "rotation_mode": "rolling",
  "max_drain_time_s": "120",
  "grace_period_s": "30",
  "reissue_batch_size": "1000"
}
```
Keep spike behind feature flag and test on staging cluster with 24h traffic replay.

raj: Spike checklist: 1) staging feature flag 2) automated canary (5% of tokens) 3) metrics: auth token errors, model-registry webhook 500s, serving fallback rate. Will create a small dashboard. ETA for spike: end of this week (first_message_ts + 7d).

maria: For the webhook queue I'll prototype an S3-backed queue consumer that guarantees at-least-once delivery and transparent dedupe via webhook idempotency key. Risk: latency bump for cold reads; mitigation: local mem cache + prefetched batches. Target PR: 2026-04-05.

jordan: Region failover test plan: 1) non-prod failover next Wed 09:00-11:00 PT 2) production dry-run (routing-only) next month 3) warm pool capacity reserve + SLA smoke. Need sign-off from infra and platform.

elaine: Also proposing a recurring review: monthly dependency-runbook audit and quarterly vendor SLA drill. This will catch regressions and recurring patterns.

sophie: Assign owners in the tracker and add acceptance criteria:
- auth rotation: rolling spike + canary metrics green for 48h
- model-registry queue: end-to-end webhook success >= 99.9% under 95th traffic replay
- failover: routing-only test with <1% error delta

maria: Noted, I'll add integration tests and synthetic webhook replays to the CI pipeline.

raj: I'll draft the rotation PR. Blocking: need a quick key-management check with security (rotate keys with zero downtime). @elaine can you help get security triage?

elaine: On it — I'll loop in sec and request a 48h review window.

ops-bot: INC-4523 status updated -> in progress. INC-4524 status updated -> in progress.

sophie: One more: ownership rotation schedule so this doesn't stall. Propose fortnightly owner sync during oncall handoff. If owner leaves, auto-assign to oncall for 72h.

jordan: fine with that. I'll add a calendar invite for the first sync.

maria: +1 to the rotation. Also we'll add a 'recurring-pattern' label if similar incidents occur 3x in 90 days.

raj: I'll include rollout feature-flag and kill-switch in the PR. If we see token error spike >0.5% in canary, auto-rollback.

elaine: I'll create the tracker rows with clear due dates and a 'close criteria' checkbox.

sophie: Great. Action items summary (from this thread):
- INC-4523 (raj): auth TTL rotation spike + backfill job, spike this week, full rollout in 2 sprints.
- INC-4524 (maria): durable webhook queue + DLQ + idempotency, PR by 2026-04-05.
- jordan: schedule region failover test (non-prod next Wed).
- elaine: coordinate security review and update postmortem + tracker.
- ops-bot: keep tickets updated and ping owners every 7 days until closed.

maria: I'll post a short design doc in #eng-ml later today.

raj: I'll drop the canary dashboard link here once created.

sophie: Thanks all — let's reconvene in two weeks for status. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync in 14 days created (thread pinned).
